title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931-2: The 'Irq el Ahmar Rock-shelter
author: (round-up; work directed by R. Neuville)
screen_term: 'Irq el Ahmar, Wadi Khureitun (QDAP 1 p. 157; spelling of gazetteer 'khareitun')
location_note: Rock-shelter in Wadi Khureitun, 2 km west of Umm Qatafa cave (QDAP 1, p. 157); no map reference; placed by name (gazetteer zone of Khareitun and Umm Qatafa). Not a held cave area.
notes: Autumn 1931 season (one third of the surface). Levels A1 (Early and Middle Bronze sherds) to I on bedrock (Mousterian and sterile). Two V-shaped stone basins in the Natufian level are portable objects, not coded.

features.subtype: rock-shelter with stratified deposits, Mousterian to Early and Middle Bronze Age
features.period: Mousterian to Early and Middle Bronze Ages (levels I to A1)
features.quote: the surface of the ‘Irq el Ahmar rock-shelter has been excavated
